title: Yandex Direct - Apps on Google Play

facts.fact: The Yandex Direct Google Play listing shows an average rating of 4.4 stars from 8.77K reviews.
The Yandex Direct app has more than 500K downloads on Google Play.
The Yandex Direct Google Play listing was last updated on Oct 20, 2026.
The Yandex Direct app is listed in the Finance category on Google Play.
The developer states that payment in the Yandex Direct app is available only in Russian rubles.
facts.quote: Payment is available only in Russian rubles in the application.

facts.fact: The developer describes Yandex Direct as showing ads on Yandex and tens of thousands of partner sites.
facts.quote: ads on Yandex and tens of thousands partner sites

facts.fact: The developer states the app may share financial info, app activity and 2 other data types with third parties.
facts.quote: Financial info, App activity and 2 others

facts.fact: The developer states the app may collect personal info, financial info and 5 other data types.
facts.quote: Personal info, Financial info and 5 others

facts.fact: The developer states that data is encrypted in transit in the Yandex Direct app.
The developer states that users can request that their data be deleted.
facts.quote: You can request that data be deleted

facts.fact: The app's content rating on Google Play is Everyone.
The developer lists the support email for the Yandex Direct app as app-direct@support.yandex.ru.
The developer, Direct Cursus Computer Systems Trading L.L.C, lists its address as Dubai World Trade Centre, United Arab Emirates.
facts.quote: Dubai World Trade Centre Office No. FLR06-06.05-7

facts.fact: The developer states that users can set up campaigns with Easy Start, edit them, and track their performance in the app.
facts.quote: Set up campaigns with Easy Start, edit them, and track their performance

facts.fact: The developer states that users can top up their advertising balance in the app.
facts.quote: top up your balance quickly and easily
